name: Basilicata
terms: Indicazione Geografica Tipica, Italy's broad regional tier.

notes: Basilicata's Aglianico del Vulture can be full bodied and richly textured, with firm tannin and chocolate-cherry notes.
Young wines can be rustic and harsh, but they soften and grow silky with age.
They can improve in bottle for 6 to 20 years.

blurb.text: An IGT covering the region of Basilicata, including Matera, Aglianico del Vulture and Terre dell'Alta Val d'Agri. Vineyards are planted mostly to Aglianico (61%), followed by Sangiovese (9%) and Primitivo (4%).
